mu_name_from: Noria's object slot 8, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object4/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under an nr_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing for the reason the ground's is: assets/textures is one flat pool for every world, and yellow_jewel.png was already taken by an item.
material_note: flower4: an atlas: a purple bloom in one corner and a woven straw band across the bottom, which is most of its area and the part that is structure.
why_this_one: Type 8, which Noria's CreateObject hands to CreateOperate: a character can walk onto this one and sit on it. Sixteen of them. See Poses.
